headline: Updated exit polls, Eisenkot victory claim, Lapid 'crushing defeat' line, pro-government polls diverge sharply, CEC first results
dek: UPDATED EXIT POLLS: Channel 13 updated poll moves Arab parties 17->18 and the Zionist anti-Netanyahu bloc 53->52 (B'Yachad 14->13, Joint List 10->11); pro-Netanyahu bloc unchanged at 50. Channel 12 updated poll keeps blocs at 52-50 but moves Democrats 9->10 and Yisrael Beytenu 9->8.
sources: Times of Israel liveblog Oct 27, 2026 (full read, crawled 00:58 Oct 28); Haaretz liveblog Oct 27, 2026; Jerusalem Post Oct 27, 2026 22:06/22:19
fault_line: Which polls are real -- the mainstream three (Netanyahu bloc 50) or Channel 14's model (bloc 60, Likud 30)? And who gets the mandate: Likud as largest party, or Eisenkot as largest bloc -- with Arab parties holding 17-18
